title: Fourier regularity of the Vandermonde density
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and form the density on the sign cube by transporting the uniform density on the row span of the associated executable Vandermonde matrix. Every nonempty coordinate set of size at most $k$ has Fourier coefficient zero for this density.
hypotheses_covered: The independence order k is positive
